provenance.statement: Repository describes itself as community-supported educational documentation with Adobe copyright. Pin is the maintained mirror revision, not an Adobe-hosted version declaration.

runtime_not_claimed: No AE invocation or new installed-host/build/render/filesystem evidence
No exclusive create, atomic replace, file durability, filesystem canonicalization or concurrent writer guarantee
No universal native JSON, modern JavaScript, Node or UXP facilities in ExtendScript
No I/O timeout or asynchronous execution implied by bounded byte counts, sleep, timer or execute
No complete runtime claim for ScriptUI, BridgeTalk, Socket, ExternalObject, E4X, reflection/localization or debugger
scope: Full text of all73 Markdown pages under docs/ at the pinned JavaScript Tools Guide revision:8 runtime/File/Folder,31 ScriptUI/BridgeTalk and34 additional runtime/data/tooling pages. Includes navigation and historical materials. This is a page/operation review, not all member signatures, a modern AE/OS support matrix or execution evidence. Supplemental Adobe samples and dated vendor pages are outside73.

reviews.operation: Provenance: shared MkDocs infrastructure supplies no runtime capability or support contract.
Preserve historical profiler overhead, hit/timing modes, CSV export and timer precision as distinct from V2 features.
Distinguish saved editor workspace state from host state and concurrent or modal execution context.
Separate the independent ESTK engine from the host engine and selected stack-frame Console/variable context.
Preserve ESTK as historical tooling and route current debugger use to the official Adobe V2 documentation.
Treat loaded OMV dictionaries as descriptions of a subsystem rather than host execution evidence.
Distinguish opening versus executing JSX and editor favorites versus host startup locations.
Separate syntax checks, dictionary completion, build comments and source navigation from AE operation correctness.
Engine diagnostics, $.error versus File.error, executing files versus reading data, sleep/timer limitations and synchronous I/O boundaries
Inspect bounded metadata before getters; distinguish dataType from access-mode type and account for incomplete dynamic member lists.
Map reflection, localization, units, dialogs and operator extensions to their concrete operation sections.
Use explicit localization with a fallback, stable transport keys and scoped locale changes; avoid internal Adobe ZString dependencies.
Account for operand order and undefined fallback; convert custom numeric objects explicitly before serialization.
Trusted source inclusion, runtime/data distinction and the historical host-specific targetengine support boundary
Convert physical dimensions through per-instance baseUnit and explicit DPI; validate finite inputs/results and quarantine the incorrect feet-to-inches sample.
Distinguish prompt cancellation from an empty accepted value and validate before project mutation.
Keep the historical CS5 Socket application list separate from current host compatibility claims.
Define bounded message framing, partial reads, receive-buffer EOF, Boolean writes, explicit close, and missing TLS/connect-cancel guarantees.
Reject unbounded client reads and busy server polling; communicate through the accepted Socket, not the listener.
Conversion, partial multibyte and filesystem failure outcomes; primary and close error reporting without treating English messages as stable enums
Host/OS encoding availability, explicit format policy and BINARY byte-string versus decoded text
Picker cancellation and type, byte versus character I/O, explicit modes and close outcomes, separate handles, bounded ingestion, destructive copy/rename limits and original UTF-8 export
Chosen folder ownership, nullable root parent, nonrecursive create contract, current/userData/temp/startup distinctions and materialized directory enumeration limit
Link existing File/Folder recipes without duplicating the eight previously reviewed pages.
URI/native paths, explicit base, alias/path traversal limits, encoding/BOM detection conflicts and preservation of primary I/O errors before cleanup
Route common runtime features separately from the application-specific AE DOM.
Describe C exports, UTF-8/NUL strings, library memory release, script-return execution, and termination prose conflicts without reconstructed declarations.
Track server init/term and object initialize/finalize, tagged data ownership and live-object release variants; quarantine copied signatures and unverified structure ABI.
Separate library search from load; scope shared search/log settings and avoid treating a found binary as ABI verification.
Qualify the CS4/VS2005/Xcode2.4 example route as historical and require a separate library ABI contract.
Distinguish direct wrapper calls from library-defined classes and record the unload/terminate inconsistency.
Separate the ExtendScript E4X subset from JSON and modern panel JavaScript syntax.
Select XMLList cardinality and namespace URI before targeted mutation; avoid replacing or deleting all matching nodes unintentionally.
Scope parser settings, distinguish copy/alias and node traversal, serialize with toXMLString, and preserve parser complexity/source typing gaps.
